nodes.name: Telekine Palm
nodes.desc: Manipulate objects at range, clear hazard patches, or extract a downed ally to your position. Costs 1-2 SE.

nodes.desc: Telekine Dome that halts daemonic entry. On dissipation, restores 50-100% of HP allies lost inside it. Costs 2-3 SE.

nodes.desc: Dominate holds targets for +2s.

nodes.desc: Enemies held by Dominate gain 4 stacks of Soulblaze.

nodes.desc: Telekine Palm range +50%. Hazard clearing radius +40%.

nodes.name: Sundering Pull
nodes.desc: Extracting an ally staggers enemies along the path.

nodes.name: Consecrated Ground
nodes.desc: Sanctic Dome also cleanses 25% of a wound of Corruption on dissipation.

nodes.name: Ember Thrift
nodes.desc: Sanctic Dome costs 1 fewer Soul Ember.

nodes.name: Anathema
